Liveness probe port mismatch (probe targeting 8081 while nginx listens on 80).   2. Problem summary - A pod mem-oom-hog-dff8847ff-drdhd in namespace boutique-quota-cpu is CrashLoopBackOff because the container runtime fails to start the container: it attempts to execute the string "--vm" as the container process and fails with "executable file not found in $PATH".  Scope and affected resources - Cluster/context: edge1 - Namespace: boutique-quota-cpu - Affected workload: Deployment mem-oom-hog -> ReplicaSet mem-oom-hog-dff8847ff -> Pod mem-oom-hog-dff8847ff-drdhd - Single container named stress in that pod - No other resources (Services, endpoints, nodes) show related failures  Evidence collected - Pod status: mem-oom-hog-dff8847ff-drdhd 0/1 CrashLoopBackOff, Restart Count 5 (ns_pods.txt, pods.txt). - Pod describe (pod_describe.txt) shows:   - Args listed for the container:     --vm 1 --vm-bytes 300M --vm-hang 1   - Last State Terminated Reason: StartError   - Message: failed to create containerd task: ... error during container init: exec: "--vm": executable file not found in $PATH - Events (events.txt) include repeated Failed events with exactly that error and then BackOff restarting failed container. - Deployment spec (deploy_describe.txt) shows the container image polinux/stress and lists those same Args in the Pod template. - No image pull or node issues: image pulled successfully repeatedly; nodes Ready. Misconfigured container command/args: the pod spec passed the flags as the container's entrypoint (command) rather than args, causing the runtime to try to exec "--vm" directly.
